pool_sparql:
SELECT ?period_start ?country ?countryLabelEn ?countryLabelRu (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) AS ?gold_count) WHERE {
      ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q482994 .
      ?item wdt:P577 ?date .
      BIND(YEAR(?date) AS ?year) .
      FILTER(?year >= 1950 && ?year <= 2024) .
      BIND(FLOOR(?year / 5) * 5 AS ?period_start) .
      ?item wdt:P495 ?country .
      ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabelEn FILTER(LANG(?countryLabelEn) = "en") .
      OPTIONAL { ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabelRu FILTER(LANG(?countryLabelRu) = "ru") . }
    }
    GROUP BY ?period_start ?country ?countryLabelEn ?countryLabelRu
    HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) >= 12 && COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) <= 260)
    ORDER BY DESC(?gold_count)
    LIMIT 1200
